# React Aria downstream suite

[React Aria](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum)'s `react-aria` and `react-aria-components` tests (Jest, 152 files), unmodified, on jsdom and on @ctrl/dom.

## Run

```sh
pnpm downstream:react-aria --install     # first run: clone the pinned commit and install its dependencies
pnpm downstream:react-aria --preset all  # what the results below track
```

Presets: `smoke` (8 components), `interactions` (interactions, focus and selection hooks) and `all` (what the results track).
